root_motivation: **Who:** the coding agent in Claude Code and the maintainer who ships a verb and forgets the skill. **What:** a skill that states every verb the host serves, every plan ceiling and every error code with its next step. **Why:** the plugin skill is hand-written and names six verbs, no ceiling and no error code; every hand-written boundary in this repo drifted within a week, so the sections are rendered from the host.
user_persona: A coding agent that reads `## Verbs`, `## Limits`, `## Errors` and `## Dev loop` in the plugin skill and makes the call the host accepts; a maintainer whose `cargo test` fails until `mcphost skill-gen --write` is run.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the checked-in files, When `mcphost skill-gen` runs without `--write`, Then it exits 0; Given one verb description edited by hand inside a marked section, Then it exits 1 and names the line.
Given a new `Tool::new("host.example")` added to `host_tools`, When `cargo test` runs, Then the drift test fails until `skill-gen --write` regenerates and the new verb appears under its family.

Given `AppError` gains a variant with a new `code`, When `cargo test` runs, Then the remedy test fails naming the code until `remedy()` covers it, and every remedy's named verb exists in `host_tools`.
Given the `limits` section, When rendered, Then every key of `plan.ceilings_json()` for `free` appears with its value and no number in the section is typed outside the generator.
Given a binary built without the `dev`/`push`/`repo` subcommands, When `skill-gen` renders `devloop`, Then the section says `no local verbs in this build` and names no absent verb.
Given `--url <mcp url> --section verbs`, When rendered, Then the output is derived from that host's `tools/list` and differs from the registry render only by verbs not yet deployed.

scope: src/skill_gen.rs: section rendering, splice, first-diff line, live tools/list fetch.
non_goals: Rewriting the hand-written narrative; generating README.md or llms.txt; per-client skills; the Recipes section (R9); the plugin.json version bump (wm-build land bumps).

additional.engine_form: mcphost-qjs subprocess in the python bwrap profile; cold_p95_ms measured by jsk_ac01

five_whys_trace.q: Why do agents miss verbs, ceilings and error codes?
five_whys_trace.a: The plugin skill is hand-written and states none of them; only its sandbox-API block is generated.
